from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.shower_area = Object("shower_area", self.Location)
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.drain_area = Object("drain_area", self.Location)
        self.safe_cleaning_area = Object("safe_cleaning_area", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        self.drain_popup = Object("drain_popup", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_active = Fluent("cleaning_active", BoolType())
        self.popup_detected = Fluent("popup_detected", BoolType())
        self.area_cleaned = Fluent("area_cleaned", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.cleaning_avoided = Fluent("cleaning_avoided", BoolType(), position=self.Location)

        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.popup_is_obstacle = Fluent("popup_is_obstacle", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_wet = Fluent("floor_is_wet", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.cleaning_active, self.popup_detected, self.area_cleaned, self.cleaning_avoided]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_sensors, self.popup_is_obstacle, self.floor_is_wet]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.shower_area, self.floor, self.drain_area, self.safe_cleaning_area, self.cleaning_tool, self.drain_popup]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_shower_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shower_area")
        navigate_to_shower_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shower_area)))
        navigate_to_shower_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_shower_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drain_area), False)
        navigate_to_shower_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_cleaning_area), False)
        navigate_to_shower_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drain_area), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_cleaning_area), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_drain_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drain_area")
        navigate_to_drain_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.drain_area)))
        navigate_to_drain_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), False)
        navigate_to_drain_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_drain_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_cleaning_area), False)
        navigate_to_drain_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drain_area), True)

        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area")
        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.safe_cleaning_area)))
        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.shower_area), False)
        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drain_area), False)
        navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_cleaning_area), True)

        activate_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("activate_cleaning")
        activate_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        activate_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_active))
        activate_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_active, True)

        deactivate_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_cleaning")
        deactivate_cleaning.add_precondition(self.cleaning_active)
        deactivate_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_active, False)

        grab_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("grab_cleaning_tool")
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.floor))
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool)))
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.floor), False)
        grab_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        place_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("place_cleaning_tool", at=self.Location)
        at = place_cleaning_tool.parameter("at")
        place_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        place_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, at), True)
        place_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), False)

        detect_popup = InstantaneousAction("detect_popup")
        detect_popup.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drain_area))
        detect_popup.add_precondition(self.robot_has_sensors)
        detect_popup.add_precondition(Not(self.popup_detected))
        detect_popup.add_effect(self.popup_detected, True)

        clean_area = InstantaneousAction("clean_area", position=self.Location)
        position = clean_area.parameter("position")
        clean_area.add_precondition(self.robot_at(position))
        clean_area.add_precondition(self.cleaning_active)
        clean_area.add_precondition(Not(self.area_cleaned(position)))
        clean_area.add_effect(self.area_cleaned(position), True)

        avoid_drain_cleaning = InstantaneousAction("avoid_drain_cleaning")
        avoid_drain_cleaning.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drain_area))
        avoid_drain_cleaning.add_precondition(self.popup_detected)
        avoid_drain_cleaning.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_avoided(self.drain_area)))
        avoid_drain_cleaning.add_effect(self.cleaning_avoided(self.drain_area), True)
        avoid_drain_cleaning.add_effect(self.area_cleaned(self.drain_area), True)

        return navigate_to_shower_area, navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_drain_area, navigate_to_safe_cleaning_area, activate_cleaning, deactivate_cleaning, grab_cleaning_tool, place_cleaning_tool, detect_popup, clean_area, avoid_drain_cleaning

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "clean_area": And([
                self.cleaning_active,
                self.object_at(self.drain_popup, self.drain_area),
                self.popup_is_obstacle,
                self.floor_is_wet,
                Not(self.popup_detected)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.drain_popup, self.drain_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.popup_is_obstacle, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_wet, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.shower_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.floor), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.drain_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.safe_cleaning_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cleaning_avoided(self.drain_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.popup_detected, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.area_cleaned(self.shower_area))
        problem.add_goal(self.area_cleaned(self.floor))
        problem.add_goal(self.area_cleaned(self.drain_area))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
